script_baseline_vs_uppaal_loop_batch.note: With UPPAAL terminal-miss semantics mirrored, a timestamp script reproduces deterministic trace verdicts for selected Boolean properties. It still does not evaluate deadlock or provide the timed-automata composition and mutation-oracle structure used in the paper.

cross_model_inferences.claim: Boundary continuity is not the limiting factor for this strict subset.
cross_model_inferences.evidence: All 13 chains satisfy A[] not boundary_violation under MAX_BOUNDARY_GAP=1000ms.

cross_model_inferences.claim: Connected-scene verification adds information beyond continuity audit.
cross_model_inferences.evidence: Although all boundaries pass, 8 of 13 chains fail the 3s deadline property.

cross_model_inferences.claim: PASS and FAIL chains can share similar surface vocabulary.
cross_model_inferences.evidence: Lead-vehicle, intersection, and speed-bump tags appear in both PASS and FAIL groups, so keyword presence alone is not a sufficient oracle.
